title: Heat Rescore
description:
For my Audio Engineering III class, I scored a clip from Heat and did the sound design and basic level mixing. I went a step further and made everything in VCV Rack, a software modular synth, since I was taking the modular synthesis class at the same time.

It came together in a few days. The levels and even some of the tones aren't to my satisfaction, but as a quick draft I think it's neat. VCV Rack isn't ideal for every sound here, so for a commercial project I'd tweak them or reach for a more fitting synthesis method.
